notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334170/0d5db567af0f7dd6eacbdd2f6fc57c52aadf19d5.png[/img]
Thank you for visiting the page "Prolegomena To a Hyperdimensional Interface That Will Be Able to Manifest From Three-Minute Interchanges"! This is Maki ONO from Caramel Column.

"Prolegomena To a Hyperdimensional Interface That Will Be Able to Manifest From Three-Minute Interchanges" is an experimental adventure game that examines the transcendence of interfaces by repeating 3 minutes of communication. The scenario is fully voiced, and distribution is scheduled for 2025. As our first Steam title, we are working hard to make it an interesting game.

Our entire development team would be very happy if you could add it to your wishlist. Thank you very much for your support!
